name: Good Display ESP32-133C02 (13.3")
description: Good Display ESP32-133C02 controller board for the 13.3 inch GDEP133C02 Spectra 6 panel. ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 with 16 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM, 1200x1600 portrait-native dual-controller glass, optional Ref2 buttons SW2/SW3/SW4, and an onboard microSD slot on a separate SPI bus. Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API through the tesserae-device-firmware build env `gooddisplay-esp32-133c02`; server-side pack via esp32_bin produces the same 960000-byte 4-bpp Spectra 6 frame used by the Seeed EE02/E1004 targets.
notes_md: Tested on physical Good Display ESP32-133C02 hardware with the matching tesserae-device-firmware env `gooddisplay-esp32-133c02` and board header `boards/gooddisplay_esp32_133c02.h`. Uses the T133A01/GDEP133C02 dual-controller driver shared with Seeed E1004/EE02 and the pin map from philippwaller/esphome-epaper-spectra6-133. Wire format is exactly 960000 bytes (1200*1600/2), two pixels per byte with high nibble = LEFT/even column and low nibble = RIGHT/odd column, row-major, 600 bytes per row, top-left origin. Palette nibbles match Tesserae's Spectra 6 constants (black=0x0, white=0x1, yellow=0x2, red=0x3, blue=0x5, green=0x6; 0x4 and 0x7 reserved). Ref2 buttons SW2/SW3/SW4 are wired as active-high GPIO12/13/14 and mapped to refresh/left/right; Ref1 boards simply leave those pins unused. The onboard microSD slot is on dedicated SPI pins (CLK=8, MOSI=3, MISO=5, CS=15). GPIO45 is the active-high panel power enable and a strapping pin, so external circuitry must not force it low during boot.
